results.name: existingAksSubnet
results.reason: Learn selectorで2026-03-01が最新GAと確認し、固定REST README/specのSubnet resource/name:stringとparent-child API routeを照合。existing宣言は参照のみであり、作成時properties/required属性の欠落として扱わない。
results.migration: GA移行不要。現行2026-03-01が最新公開GAと一致し、change logは同versionに追加・更新・削除なし。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name is Bicep existing-resource identity; REST API path expects subnetName:string. subnetName=last(split(aksSubnetId, '/')) selects the final subnet ID segment.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /parent is Bicep parent relationship, not REST payload. existingVirtualNetwork name comes from aksSubnetId path segment 8 and provides the virtualNetworks/{virtualNetworkName} parent route.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 is the Bicep resource header/type-version selector, not REST payload. existing reference type is Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/subnets@2026-03-01.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/subnetName/$expression-line/0 is subnetName source expression last(subnetIdParts), which selects the last segment of the passed AKS subnet resource ID; it maps to the REST subnetName route parameter:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/subnetIdParts/$expression-line/0 is subnetIdParts=split(aksSubnetId, '/'); its segment derivation supplies both child subnet name and parent VNet name used in the REST route.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/aksSubnetId/$expression-line/0 is aksSubnetId param string. main.bicep passes network.outputs.aksSubnetId, and network.bicep constructs the exact virtualNetworks/{vnetName}/subnets/snet-aks resource ID.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/aksSubnetId/$expression-line/1 is aksSubnetId param string. main.bicep passes network.outputs.aksSubnetId, and network.bicep constructs the exact virtualNetworks/{vnetName}/subnets/snet-aks resource ID.

current.analysis: Learn selector lists 2026-03-01 as Latest. Pinned Network README package-2026-03-01 includes virtualNetwork.json/common.json; Schemas resolves Subnet.name:string and REST paths expose virtualNetworks/{virtualNetworkName}/subnets/{subnetName}.

ga.analysis: Latest stable GA from Learn equals current. Same exact pinned REST versioned schema and route shape apply; existing declaration is only a lookup reference.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log says 2026-03-01 has no properties added, updated or removed. No payload properties are specified by this existing reference declaration.
